request: Build a Jac library that converts values between units of the same measure: length, mass, volume and temperature. Linear units use factors and temperature uses offsets. It lists the units of a measure and suggests the best display unit (the largest unit whose value is at least 1). main.jac converts a value given on the command line.
acceptance: 1 km is 1000 m, and 100 C is 212 F.
Converting kg to m is rejected as incompatible; an unknown unit name is rejected.
The best unit for 1500 m is 1.5 km and for 0.5 m it is 50 cm.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1. This is a Jac library with a command-line entry in main.jac, not a web app.
No network, no external APIs; the library functions are pure and tested with `jac test`.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.

support_files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 with a [project] section (name, version) and entry-point main.jac.
